The '''strange casket''' is a casket found upstairs in [[Watson's house]] in [[Hosidius]]. Players must speak to it in order to enable the chance of a reward casket turning into the [[Mimic]].

If players have a Mimic in their inventory, they can bring it to the strange casket to fight [[The Mimic]].

Should the player die in the fight, the strange casket will hold the player's items and will return them for a fee of 90,000 [[coins]] (which can be taken from its own storage). Like other [[Item Retrieval Service]]s, any items stored with the strange casket will be lost should the player die in '''any''' unsafe [[death]].
